item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Dev’s model of the Sun and eight planets in order of increasing distance from the Sun, with inner and outer groups marked. A planet is a large, nearly spherical object that revolves around the Sun. He also holds a Moon card.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Inner: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars; outer: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune — and the Moon is not a planet.
options.B: The Moon is a planet because it is nearly spherical.
options.C: Inner: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune; outer: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.
options.D: All eight planets are mostly made of gases, so the inner–outer split is only about colour.
